description: Unit tests for the TalkDirective parser in the OpenClawKit project, validating parsing logic and directive handling.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveTests
classes.description: Test case class for testing TalkDirective parsing functionality.

methods.name: testParsesDirectiveAndStripsLine
methods.description: Verifies parsing of a directive with voice and once fields and stripping the directive line from text.

methods.name: testIgnoresNonDirective
methods.description: Tests that non-directive text is handled correctly without directives.

methods.name: testKeepsDirectiveLineIfNoRecognizedFields
methods.description: Checks that unrecognized directives do not produce a directive object and the line is preserved.

methods.name: testParsesExtendedOptions
methods.description: Validates parsing of an extended directive with multiple options and normalizing the output fields.

methods.name: testSkipsLeadingEmptyLinesWhenParsingDirective
methods.description: Ensures that leading empty lines are skipped before parsing directive.

methods.name: testTracksUnknownKeys
methods.description: Checks that unknown or unrecognized keys in directive are tracked correctly.
